verbatim_provider_sources.PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedWellFormed:
import PV_STX2_OwnerWellFormed
import PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedRegistered
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedWellFormed
open PV_EVHB_OWNER PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwned PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedRegistered
open PV_STX2_OwnerWellFormed
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. Slice-5 carries
the OWNER model invariant at the mid-program slice entry. -/
structure Source7EntryOwned'' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop where
  registered : Source7EntryOwned' s value
  wellFormed : OwnerWellFormed s
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. Earlier proofs
consume the old entry obligation through this implication. -/
theorem forget {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned'' s value) :
    Source7EntryOwned' s value := entry.registered
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. The entry's
selected identity is strictly older than the next minted identity. -/
theorem entry_id_lt_next {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned'' s value) :
    PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.identity entry.registered.owned
      (PV_STX2_Source7EntryAddress.first value) < s.next := by
  exact entry.wellFormed _ _ (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.selected entry.registered.owned _).1
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. Minting cannot
reuse the entry region's identity. -/
theorem entry_id_ne_minted {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned'' s value) :
    PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.identity entry.registered.owned
      (PV_STX2_Source7EntryAddress.first value) ≠ s.next :=
  Nat.ne_of_lt (entry_id_lt_next entry)
#print axioms Source7EntryOwned''
#print axioms forget
#print axioms entry_id_lt_next
#print axioms entry_id_ne_minted
end PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedWellFormed
verbatim_provider_sources.PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed:
import PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedWellFormed
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed
open PV_EVHB_OWNER PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwned
open PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedRegistered PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedWellFormed
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. D812 extends the
slice-4 caller registration clause to every column; slice-5 is retained. -/
structure Source7EntryOwned''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop where
  owned : Source7EntryOwned s value
  wellFormed : PV_STX2_OwnerWellFormed.OwnerWellFormed s
  registered : ∀ i : Fin value.c1.val.length,
    s.places (PV_STX2_Source7QBinding.ownerPlace
      ⟨0,(PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header owned i).pointer,[]⟩) =
    s.places (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.place owned i)
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. The first-column
registration is precisely the corresponding indexed instance. -/
theorem forget {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned''' s value) :
    Source7EntryOwned'' s value := by
  refine ⟨⟨entry.owned, ?_⟩, entry.wellFormed⟩
  exact entry.registered (PV_STX2_Source7EntryAddress.first value)
/-- Conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. The same
Foundation-construction obligation now supplies every address registration. -/
def FoundationConstructionEntryObligation''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop :=
  Source7EntryOwned''' s value
#print axioms Source7EntryOwned'''
#print axioms forget
#print axioms FoundationConstructionEntryObligation'''
end PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed
verbatim_provider_sources.PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned:
import PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned
open PV_EVHB_OWNER PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwned
/-- Slice-11 adds exactly typed reference alignment to the existing entry
obligation. M31 has element alignment four in the pinned client layout. The
same chosen headers and registrations are retained, without re-selection. -/
structure Source7EntryOwned'''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop where
  previous : PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed.Source7EntryOwned''' s value
  aligned : ∀ i : Fin value.c1.val.length,
    (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header previous.owned i).pointer % 4 = 0
/-- The caller's existing Foundation-construction obligation, refined only
by the reference validity clause authorized in LOG D912. -/
def FoundationConstructionEntryObligation'''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop :=
  Source7EntryOwned'''' s value
/-- Literal implication to the unchanged old obligation. -/
theorem forget {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned'''' s value) :
    PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed.FoundationConstructionEntryObligation''' s value :=
  entry.previous
/-- Entry provenance supplies alignment for every column, including every
iteration of the source7 loop, and for zero-length typed regions. -/
theorem column {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned'''' s value)
    (i : Fin value.c1.val.length) :
    (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header entry.previous.owned i).pointer % 4 = 0 :=
  entry.aligned i
/-- Transport of typed entry validity uses the identical source header
preserved by the run, never destination freshness or a pointer alias premise. -/
theorem registered_header {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation}
    (entry : Source7EntryOwned'''' s value) (i : Fin value.c1.val.length)
    (current : OWNER)
    (preserved : PV_EVHB_OWNER.receiver current (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.place entry.previous.owned i) =
      some (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.identity entry.previous.owned i,
        PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header entry.previous.owned i)) :
    ∃ id h, PV_EVHB_OWNER.receiver current (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.place entry.previous.owned i) =
      some (id,h) ∧ h.pointer % 4 = 0 :=
  ⟨_,_,preserved,entry.aligned i⟩
#print axioms Source7EntryOwned''''
#print axioms FoundationConstructionEntryObligation''''
#print axioms forget
#print axioms column
#print axioms registered_header
end PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned
verbatim_provider_sources.PV_STX2_Source7EntryReferenceValid:
import PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned
set_option autoImplicit false
/-! All statements are conditional on owner acceptance of the translator patch. -/
noncomputable section
namespace PV_STX2_Source7EntryReferenceValid
open PV_EVHB_OWNER PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwned
/-- LOG D918: the same entry-selected typed slice is non-null, aligned and
its initialized byte range does not wrap the pinned 64-bit address space.
The bound concerns the slice length, not unused RawVec capacity. -/
structure Source7EntryOwned''''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop where
  previous : PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned.Source7EntryOwned'''' s value
  nonnull : ∀ i : Fin value.c1.val.length,
    (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header previous.previous.owned i).pointer ≠ 0
  bounded : ∀ i : Fin value.c1.val.length,
    (PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header previous.previous.owned i).pointer +
      (values value i).length * 4 ≤ 2^64

def FoundationConstructionEntryObligation''''' (s : OWNER) (value : Foundation) : Prop :=
  Source7EntryOwned''''' s value

theorem forget79 {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned''''' s value) :
    PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedAligned.FoundationConstructionEntryObligation'''' s value :=
  entry.previous
theorem forget {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned''''' s value) :
    PV_STX2_Source7EntryOwnedIndexed.FoundationConstructionEntryObligation''' s value :=
  entry.previous.previous
theorem column {s : OWNER} {value : Foundation} (entry : Source7EntryOwned''''' s value)
    (i : Fin value.c1.val.length) :
    let h := PV_STX2_Source7EntrySelection.header entry.previous.previous.owned i
    h.pointer ≠ 0 ∧ h.pointer % 4 = 0 ∧ h.pointer + (values value i).length*4 ≤ 2^64 :=
  ⟨entry.nonnull i,entry.previous.aligned i,entry.bounded i⟩
#print axioms Source7EntryOwned'''''
#print axioms FoundationConstructionEntryObligation'''''
#print axioms forget79
#print axioms forget
#print axioms column
end PV_STX2_Source7EntryReferenceValid

qualification: Before: Source7EntryOwned''. After: the existing FoundationConstructionEntryObligation'''''. CallerClauses assembles exactly the indexed registration and reference-validity refinements; actual Foundation builder provenance remains the named caller obligation, never inferred from ownership alone.
